verdicts.originalText: The Tranquility Aura summon is authored on this base E ability so that the canonical "E E E E" rotation (initial cast → WS1 → WS2 → WS3) renders correctly, even though in-game the aura only spawns after the third Whirling Steps press (WS3). Rotations that don't reach WS3 (e.g. "E swap" or "E E swap") will incorrectly show an aura — verify against your intended rotation. Additionally, in Lunar Prayer state (8s after a Sword Dance combo), pressing E does not fire Whirling Steps in-game, but the planner currently allows it. This is a tool limitation.
verdicts.proposedText: The follower aura is shown from the first cast, but in game it appears only after the third Whirling Steps press; rotations ending sooner wrongly show it. In Lunar Prayer state, pressing E won't fire Whirling Steps in game, but the timeline allows it.
verdicts.rationale: Two real user-facing divergences are kept: (a) the follower aura is displayed from the first cast even for short rotations that never reach the third in-stance E press, and (b) the tool lets E fire Whirling Steps during Lunar Prayer, which can't happen in game. The opening implementation rationale (aura authored on base E so the canonical E-E-E-E rotation displays) is curator-facing and demoted. Not implementDelete: the WS chain is modeled-but-unreachable (WS2/WS3 variants exist but the parser resolves WS1 for every in-stance E press per the curator notes), so this is a divergence, not working behavior. Original named the character-adjacent proper nouns fine but named the ability context and used the banned word 'renders'; rewrite de-names and drops it. [Adjudicated: verifier-suggested parenthetical trim clears the sentence-count WARN.]

demotedNotes: The Tranquility Aura is authored on the base skill so the canonical E-E-E-E rotation (initial cast → WS1 → WS2 → WS3) displays correctly even though in-game it spawns only after WS3 — rationale already covered in existing notes. verdicts.implementQueueNote: Deferred parser/state work: chain-state selection so the three in-stance E presses resolve to WS1 → WS2 → WS3 (parser currently picks WS1 for every in-stance E press), plus gating E-triggered Whirling Steps out of the Lunar Prayer state.
